```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
league_df <- readr::read_csv("data/laser_league_players.csv") %>%
  mutate(hover_commuter = if_else(commute_mode == "Hover Tram", "Hover", "Other"))
```

```{r}
league_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(tag_accuracy_pct, fill = hover_commuter)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, position = "identity", bins = 20) +
  facet_wrap(~ hover_commuter) +
  labs(title = "Accuracy distribution by commute mode", x = "Tag accuracy (%)")
```

```{r}
ttest_result <- t.test(tag_accuracy_pct ~ hover_commuter, data = league_df)
ttest_result
```

```{r}
contingency <- table(league_df$preferred_channel, league_df$favorite_drink)
chi_result <- chisq.test(contingency)
chi_result
```

## Notes
Briefly explain what the p-values tell you.
